$sources: The species: Haplocladium microphyllum (Hedw.) Broth., a pleurocarpous moss of soil, rock and tree bases throughout China, in loose to dense mats, the stems creeping, irregularly pinnate, 1-3 cm (Moss Flora of China, vol. 6, Thuidiaceae, Science Press and Missouri Botanical Garden 2002).
The garden ground under moss: the Chenghuai sheet, section 7.
name: Haplocladium microphyllum
note: A carpet over the garden ground, less the pond: its leafLengthMeters is the mat's depth over the soil. The museum shows it in early summer, Mangzhong to Xiazhi (June).
